info.title: Product posting API
info.description: Supplemental API referenced by the official POP solution but absent from the current category catalog; availability and app permission are unverified.

items.description: Qualification information. Please note that deleting the product qualification information will result in the product being penalized for non-compliance, so please do not delete the product qualification information.

key.description: Qualification information key, the key under each category is not the same, please call the qualification information query interface: aliexpress.category.qualifications.list, query the key and type of the corresponding

value.description: Specific qualification information: image link or text

items.description: Only available for polish seller right now!!! This parameter is used to set different product main images in various countries

main_image_urls.description: Max Number: 6, use ';' to split multiple image links

store_delivery_type.description: "storePickup" indicates in-store pickup and is a required field. It can support multiple values, separated by commas. "homeDelivery" indicates home delivery. Only for Saudi Arabia seller

weight_unit.description: weight unit of item. pound or ounce,  1 represents pound and 2 represents ounce. (This field right now is only available for us seller))

inventory_deduction_strategy.description: Indicate when the inventory of a specific product will be deducted:  1) place_order_withhold: the inventory is deducted just after the order is placed by customer.  2) payment_success_deduct: the stock is deducted after the payment is done successfully by the customer.

freight_template_id.description: Freight Template ID / Freight Strategy ID. After the merchant has created an freight template in the seller center backend: freighttemplate.aliexpress.com, the id could be obtained in the seller center directly or thourgh the API: aliexpress.freight.redefining.listfreighttemplate. Please note that the default template with id:1000 is not applicable to oversea sellers. For sellers who need to use a freight strategy, the corresponding ID can also be found in the seller center or queried using aliexpress.freight.redefining.listfreighttemplate.

subject.description: Deprecated. Please use  multi_language_subject_list. 1-218 length, support multi language. Check the field "language" to find the supported languages.

size_chart_id.description: merchant's size chart id,  mainly used in the category of shoes and clothes.

brand_name.description: Brand name, which can be found after applied in seller center. If the seller has not applied any brand permission, please leave this field blank.

shipping_lead_time.description: refer to the preparation period of merchant before the package could be dispatched to the customer. Minimum:1

weight.description: Weight of the product, including package. Measured in Kilograms (Kg) with a maximum 500 and minumum 0.001

items.description: Main image that represents the product. The url should be accesible and there is a maximum of 6 pictures. The url can point to a seller's server or to AliExpress photobank. In order to obtain more information about the photobank and how to upload images, please visit the following api: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk

package_length.description: Package length, measured in centimeters (cm). Maximum 700 cm, minumum: 1 cm

items.description: There are 4 types of how to fill in the content of each element in this attribute list. 1). When filling in the standard dropdown/multi-dropdown attributes, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "aliexpress_attribute_value_id"(For multi-dropdown, splitting them into multiple elements)  2). When filling in the attributes in which the value needs to be manually entered, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "attribute_value" in the element. 3). There exists a special kind of "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" of which the value represents for "Other". When encoutering this scenario, please fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id", "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" and "attribute_value". 4). Besides the three types mentioned above, if the seller would like to fully customized all the atttributes, fill in  "attribute name" and "attribute_value" in the element. For further information, please refer to the following link: https://openservice.aliexpress.com/doc/doc.htm?nodeId=27493&docId=118729#/?docId=1375

aliexpress_attribute_value_id.description: aliexpress attribute value id, which could be obtained from https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2. The path is: result -> attributes ->values -> id

aliexpress_attribute_name_id.description: aliexpress attribute name id, which could be obtained from https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2. The path is: result -> attributes -> id

description.description: Deprecated, please use product description, support html format and multi languages. Check the field language to find the supported languages.

package_height.description: Package height measured in centimeters (cm). Maximum 700 cm, minumum: 1cm

items.description: All the skus included in one product.

sku_attribute_value.description: Customized sku attribute value by sellers, do not include these 4 symbols { # : = , }.maximum 70 characters.

sku_attribute_name.description: Deprecated, please use sku_attribute_name_id. To obtain the available sku attribute names under a specific category, please check API: aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query.

sku_attribute_name_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_name_id under specific category

sku_attribute_value_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_value_id under specific category

items.description: sku attribute list. Some categories don't have sku attributes, then sku_attributes_list should be empty.When there are more than one sku in the sku_info_list, sku_attributes_list is required for each of them, please do not let them empty

Image that will represent the variation of the product. The url can point to a seller's server or to AliExpress photobank. In order to obtain more information about the photobank and how to upload images, please visit the following api: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk

sku_image_url.description: Image that will represent the variation of the product. The url can point to a seller's server or to AliExpress photobank. In order to obtain more information about the photobank and how to upload images, please visit the following api: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk

sku_attribute_value.description: Customized sku attribute value by sellers, do not include these 4 symbols { # : = , }.maximum 70 characters.

sku_attribute_name.description: Deprecated, please use sku_attribute_name_id. To obtain the available sku attribute names under a specific category, please check API: aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query.

sku_attribute_name_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_name_id under specific category

sku_attribute_value_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_value_id under specific category

bar_code.description: barcode of the sku. Except some Russian sellers who will be fulfilled by Aliexpress, please ignore this field for other sellers.

sku_code.description: Merchant's identificator for the SKU. Important reference to maintain the sku relationship between merchant and Aliexpress.

discount_price.description: discount price for the sku. discount_price should be cheaper than price.

extra_params.description: extra params. Configured some special products

ean_code.description: EAN, or EAN13, stands for International Article Number (originally European Article Number). It is an extension of the UPC codes and you'll find them as barcodes on most everyday products. Sometimes the barcode is also called GTIN or GTIN13 (Global Trade Identifier)

service_policy_id.description: Service Policy ID, which can be set and obtained in the seller's background. If the merchant wishes to use the default setting, they can pass "0" as the parameter. However, for some specific countries like Korea, it is recommended to leave this field blank.

language.description: The main language of the product. Aliexpress will depend on the subject and detail in main language to translate to other languages, if not filled in by sellers. Main language could not be modified after product has been uploaded. Support: en(English) ru(Russian) es(Spanish) fr(French) it(Italian) tr(Turkish) pt(Portuguese) de(German) nl(Dutch) in(Indonesian) ar(Arabic) ja(Japanese) ko(Korean) th(Thai) vi(Vietnamese) iw(Hebrew)

package_width.description: Package width measured in centimeters (cm). Maximum 700 cm, minumum: 1cm

aliexpress_category_id.description: Aliexpress leaf category ID, obtained through aliexpress.solution.seller.category.tree.query

product_unit.description: Product Unit ID, Most common-used ID: 100000015 piece/pieces; 100000000:bag/bags; 100000001:barrel/barrels; 100000002:bushel/bushels; 100078580:carton; 100078581:centimeter; 100000003:cubic meter; 100000004:dozen; 100078584:feet; 100000005:gallon; 100000006:gram; 100078587:inch; 100000007:kilogram; 100078589:kiloliter; 100000008:kilometer; 100078559:liter/liters; 100000009:long ton; 100000010:meter; 100000011:metric ton; 100078560:milligram; 100078596:milliliter; 100078597:millimeter; 100000012:ounce; 100000014:pack/packs; 100000013:pair; 100000016:pound; 100078603:quart; 100000017:set/sets; 100000018:short ton; 100078606:square feet; 100078607:square inch; 100000019:square meter; 100078609:square yard; 100000020:ton; 100078558:yard/yards

language.description: Support: en(English) ru(Russian) es(Spanish) fr(French) it(Italian) tr(Turkish) pt(Portuguese) de(German) nl(Dutch) in(Indonesian) ar(Arabic) ja(Japanese) ko(Korean) th(Thai) vi(Vietnamese) iw(Hebrew).Must contains the original locale.

web_detail.description: web detail for this language, please check the format here: https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=109534&docType=1

mobile_detail.description: mobile detail for this language, do not support "html" and "dynamic" type, for more information, please check the format here https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=109534&docType=1

language.description: Support: en(English) ru(Russian) es(Spanish) fr(French) it(Italian) tr(Turkish) pt(Portuguese) de(German) nl(Dutch) in(Indonesian) ar(Arabic) ja(Japanese) ko(Korean) th(Thai) vi(Vietnamese) iw(Hebrew).Must contains the original locale.

group_id.description: group id, you can get group list from aliexpress.product.productgroups.get

price_type.description: Support absolute or delete. When filling in "delete", the multi_country_price_configuration will be eliminated.

ship_to_country.description: ISO code of the country. Currently supporting: RU, US, CA, ES, FR, UK, NL, IL, BR, CL, AU, UA, BY, JP, TH, SG, KR, ID, MY, PH, VN, IT, DE, SA, AE, PL, TR

items.description: Sku price list under the same ship_to_country

price.description: Value of price configuration. If the price of a specific country is set, it must be greater than or equal to 70% of the original sku price

discount_price.description: Value of discount_price for each country, should be less than the retailPrice and greater than or equal to 10% of it.

extra_params.description: extra params. Configured some special products

items.description: marketing images for product. Currently supported 2 types: 1 represents 3:4 rectangle(resolution at least 750*1000) image while 2 represents 1:1 square image(Resolution at least 800*800). The image url needs to be obtained via uploading the image through Aliexpress API: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk(https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=30186&docType=2)

image_type.description: 1 represents 3:4 rectangle(resolution at least 750*1000) image while 2 represents 1:1 square image(Resolution at least 800*800).

image_url.description: The image url needs to be obtained via uploading the image through Aliexpress API: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk(https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=30186&docType=2)

product_id.description: When invoked successfully, Aliexpress will return a product Id.

data.codeDesc: Seller operation rights have been suspended. Please contact customer service.
data.solution: 商家权限被冻结，请联系商家后台客服进行相关处理

data.codeDesc: The required attribute value {0} of the product cannot be empty, please fill it in as required
data.solution: 报错信息中透出的必填属性没有填写，请获取类目属性传递必填属性信息

data.codeDesc: Due to EU GPSR (General Product Safety Regulation) compliance requirements, EU Responsible Person information must be included when listing or editing product information, and this data can be retrieved via the aliexpress.merchant.msr.list API.
data.solution: 出于欧盟 GPSR合规需求，需要在商品发布或者编辑的信息中添加欧盟责任人信息，可以从aliexpress.merchant.msr.list 这个 api 获取查询

data.codeDesc: 商品主图校验失败：图片URL非平台合法链接、图片内容为空、或主图列表字段缺失
data.solution: 1. 请先通过速卖通图片上传接口（参考文档 docId=30186）将原始图片上传至平台，获取平台返回的合法图片URL后，再填入 main_image_urls_list 字段；禁止直接使用第三方CDN图片链接。2. 确保 main_image_urls_list 字段不为空且每张图片内容有效（非空白图片）。

data.codeDesc: 请求中的类目 ID 200003495（Men's Sets）已在平台下线停用，类目校验不通过，该业务异常被统一包装为系统错误码 750000000（真实下游码 5000000001）。
data.solution: 1. 请先调用类目查询接口获取当前有效的叶子类目 ID，选择与商品实际品类匹配的类目，替换请求中的 category_id（200003495 已停用）后重新发布。2. 请勿在本地长期缓存类目 ID，建议定期同步最新类目表，并在发布前校验类目是否仍为启用状态。

data.name: app_key
data.desc: Unique app ID issued by AE Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

data.name: timestamp
data.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 2022-04-28 10:46:37 (TOP Protocol) or 1651113997000 (GOP Protocol), with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

data.name: sign_method
data.desc: The HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature

data.name: sign
data.desc: Part of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click here for details)

When encoutering this scenario, please fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id", "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" and "attribute_value". 4).
